common_gotchas: Sending is done through Python methods such as send() and sendBytes(); wiring a DAT input does not automatically transmit rows.
UDP Out DAT can receive replies, so its table contents may include incoming data as well as status expectations.
Use Local Address and Local Port Mode when a host has multiple NICs or a protocol requires a stable source port.
Multicast destinations require multicast-compatible network configuration.
Windows firewall or OS network permissions can block outgoing or reply traffic.
key_concepts: UDP Out DAT sends UDP or multicast UDP messages using DAT class send methods.
Although it is an output operator, replies from destinations can appear in its DAT contents.
Local address and local port controls help bind the outgoing socket on multi-NIC or protocol-sensitive systems.
Callbacks and clamp settings handle and bound any received reply rows.
